item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence of a sustained domestic-crisis strategy built around protection, restraint, and non-retaliation.\nThe positive evidence is limited to narrow clemency and a temporary pause on hijab-law implementation.\nI found no convincing proof of a broader shift away from intimidation, collective punishment, censorship, or militarized spectacle in response to domestic flare-ups.","evidence":[{"title":"Iran: Draconian campaign to enforce compulsory veiling laws through surveillance and mass car confiscations","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/","summary":"Amnesty described surveillance, mass police checks, confiscations, prosecutions, flogging, prison terms, and “morality” classes used to enforce veiling rules. This is a coercive, fear-based response to domestic social tension, not restrained crisis management.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.5","3B.8","3B.2"]},{"title":"Iran chokehold on dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/iran-chokehold-dissent","summary":"HRW reported that authorities killed hundreds of protesters, arrested thousands, and tortured detainees while failing to open transparent investigations. That is direct evidence against protection or restraint in response to domestic unrest.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Iran executes 853 people in eight-year high amid relentless repression and renewed war on drugs","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-04-04","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/04/iran-executes-853-people-in-eight-year-high-amid-relentless-repression-and-renewed-war-on-drugs/","summary":"Amnesty reported a major execution surge, including mass use of the death penalty after unfair Revolutionary Court trials. This indicates punitive escalation during domestic crisis conditions rather than de-escalation.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Iran security forces rape, torture detainees","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-04-22","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/04/22/iran-security-forces-rape-torture-detainees","summary":"HRW documented rape, torture, sexual assault, and coerced false confessions during the protest crackdown.
